summary: シヴィア ADC into ソナ support is a lane where you win by controlling the wave and denying ソナ's slow poke-sustain scaling. ソナ's ヒム・オブ・ヴァロー and パワーコード will chip you down if you stand idle near the wave, but シヴィア can answer by pushing with 跳刃, blocking the key moment with スペルシールド, and forcing ソナ to heal under tower instead of freely trading.
winCondition: Push first, trade only when ソナ walks up for ヒム・オブ・ヴァロー or パワーコード, and use スペルシールド for クレッシェンド after level 6. If you keep the lane moving, ソナ spends mana reacting to waves instead of scaling comfortably. 地味だけど、それが一番嫌がらせになる。
threatModel: ソナ's ヒム・オブ・ヴァロー is targeted poke around minions, so hiding behind the wave does not fully protect you; spacing matters more than minion cover.
パワーコード after several casts makes her next auto much more dangerous, especially if she steps forward with the Q aura already active.
クレッシェンド is the real kill setup after level 6; if スペルシールド is down, ソナ can start fights that her ADC finishes.
trading: When ソナ walks up to tag Q, answer with ブーメランブレード through her retreat path, not where she is standing; she usually backs off right after casting.
Use 跳刃 on the wave when ソナ and her ADC stand close to minions, because bounce damage punishes her low durability without needing to overstep.
Do not chase through her セレリティ movement speed unless your support has crowd control ready; short trades favor you, long messy chases let her heal and reset.

lanePlan.levels1to3: Level 1, use 跳刃 or careful autos to get push without eating free Q-auto from ソナ. Level 2, respect her empowered パワーコード timing; if she has stacks, step back until she uses it or loses the angle. Level 3, スペルシールド lets you trade more confidently, but do not waste it on harmless poke if a jungle gank timing is near.
lanePlan.preSix: Keep the wave slightly pushing toward ソナ's tower and make her choose between healing damage or helping her ADC last-hit. Your poke is best when ブーメランブレード hits on both the outgoing and returning path after she uses Q and has no reason to keep walking forward.
lanePlan.postSix: Hold スペルシールド for クレッシェンド unless you are certain ソナ cannot all-in. 戦姫の号令 is stronger as a punish tool than a panic button here: use it when ソナ's R is blocked or missed, then run her down before パーセヴァランス can undo the trade.
lanePlan.wave: Push with 跳刃 when your support can ward river or pressure tower; freezing for too long gives ソナ quiet time to stack haste and heal. If enemy jungle is missing, thin the wave instead of hard pushing, because シヴィア without E is still easy to collapse on.
lanePlan.recall: A good recall is after crashing a large wave, because ソナ is weak at instantly clearing it. Do not recall on a neutral wave after being poked low; she and her ADC can freeze, and then every return to lane becomes another Q tax. 悲しいね。

runes.keystone: フリートフットワーク
runes.mainWhy: Take フリートフットワーク because ソナ creates a repeated small-damage problem, not one single burst problem before level 6. The heal and movement speed help シヴィア survive Q poke, step out after last-hitting, and keep enough health to use wave pressure instead of being forced into bad recalls.
runes.subWhy: 魔道 fits because this lane is about spacing and repeated spell trades. Extra poke or movement-focused scaling helps ブーメランブレード and 戦駆け turn short windows into safe damage without needing to all-in through ソナ's healing.

items.firstBuy: 理想の初回帰還はB. F. ソード。ブーメランブレードの往復ダメージと跳刃の押し返しが強くなり、ソナを塔下に置きやすい。かなり削られているならヴァンパイア セプターでレーン維持を優先。
items.coreReason: Core direction is critical strike plus attack speed: インフィニティ エッジ, ナヴォリ フリッカーブレード, and attack-speed crit items let シヴィア clear waves fast and keep R後の通常攻撃回転を活かせる。ソナ戦は長引くほど面倒なので、押し込み速度がそのまま圧になる。
items.defensive: If クレッシェンド or magic poke keeps deciding fights, マーキュリー ブーツ or クイックシルバー サッシュ are the clean defensive adjustments. Damageだけ積んで捕まるADCは、まあ置物だから。
items.situational: If your team needs faster lane control and rotations, スタティック シヴ is a reasonable situational choice because wave clear makes ソナ leave safe healing positions. If enemy frontline is stacking armor, ラスト ウィスパー into armor penetration direction instead.
items.whenBehind: When behind, stop rushing greed damage and buy lifesteal or defensive movement first: ヴァンパイア セプター, プレート スチールキャップ, or マーキュリー ブーツ depending on who is killing you. Your job becomes clearing safely with Q/W and saving E for the engage, not forcing hero trades.

hit: Aim ブーメランブレード through ソナ's exit path after she casts ヒム・オブ・ヴァロー, because she usually turns back immediately after poking.
Use 跳刃 when ソナ stands beside low-health caster minions; the bounces make her pay for staying in aura range.
After blocking クレッシェンド with スペルシールド, cast 戦姫の号令 and chase in a straight line only if her セレリティ is already used.
dodge: Sidestep away from ソナ before her Q range, not after the blue bolts appear; the spell is hard to avoid once she is already close.
Track パワーコード stacks visually and back up when the empowered auto is ready, especially after she used Q last.
Post-6, keep a slight diagonal angle instead of standing directly in front of ソナ, so クレッシェンド is easier to shield or sidestep.

teamfights: Do not spend スペルシールド early on random poke if ソナ is visible with クレッシェンド ready; blocking that one spell can decide the whole fight.
Use 戦姫の号令 to start a punish after ソナ misses R or steps too far forward, not just to run into her team's full engage.
Hit the closest safe target while 跳刃 spreads damage; diving ソナ first is only correct if her R is down and your team can follow instantly.
commonMistakes: Using スペルシールド on ヒム・オブ・ヴァロー every time, then having nothing for クレッシェンド. That trade is usually not worth it after level 6.
Letting ソナ farm free アッチェレランド stacks by playing a passive, frozen lane with no pressure. シヴィア should make her answer waves.
Throwing ブーメランブレード from max range with no setup; if it misses, ソナ gets a free poke-and-heal cycle while your main trade tool is down.
